title: Quantum Software Quality: Evidence, Assurance Mechanisms, and Model-Level Limits—A Survey

creators.name: Vieira de Camargo, Valter
creators.affiliation: Universidade Federal de São Carlos, Brazil

description:
Reproduction materials accompanying the survey with the same title, prepared for ACM Computing Surveys. The package preserves 243 selected bibliographic records and consolidates only the two MorphQ++ manifestations into one evidence group: 242 groups, 241 with analytical records, 239 with normalized items, 1,554 items, 5,492 classification scopes, 3,700 memberships and 86 categories. Figure 4 contains 28 same-item cells and 381 associated items. Both MorphQ++ DOI and all eligibility decisions are retained. The historical pilot reports researcher–automated agreement, not agreement between two human reviewers; the 22 operational definitions explain existing categories.

CC BY 4.0 applies only to original QCC contributions identified in LICENSE_MATRIX.csv and LICENSE_SCOPE.md. Original code retains MIT and embedded font components retain their notices. All six original bibliographic files and both complete spreadsheets are retained. The authors confirm authorized institutional research access; the actual retrieval route and applicable redistribution conditions remain unverified. No applicable prohibition has been demonstrated, and basic bibliographic facts are not treated as protected abstracts. Version 2.0.0 was published on 2026-11-18; publication does not establish documentary closure of the rights reservation; the license on original curation is not evidence of contractual redistribution permission. Cited publications are not relicensed.

Historical version DOI 10.5281/zenodo.24168011 belongs to concept DOI 10.5281/zenodo.24168010. Published version 2.0.0 has DOI 10.5281/zenodo.24349998 under that same concept DOI, as recorded by Zenodo. No article DOI is assigned here. This approved documentary correction does not replace the archived files or create a new deposit.
